Messages.Author: Bernard M. Bresnahan
Messages.Body:
I Plan on being there. Last year the Tourney was run by Shawn Carnes
(as I guess you'd remember) who was a playtester at that time (and as
some remember, our NetRep for a period of time).

Many of my Friends and I made the trek from Michigan to see the new
Sabbat cards last year, only to find out that the boneheads from WOTC
forgot to bring them (DUH). So they were to be shipped in FedEx the
next day, lot of good that did us.

I'd like to talk with folks and discuss how people feel tournaments
should be run? The future of V:TES, that kind of stuff.

See ya at Origins,

-- Bernie
